assertions.test: typeof WebTransport === 'function' && 'createSendGroup' in WebTransport.prototype && typeof WebTransport.prototype.createSendGroup === 'function'

assertions.description: The WebTransportSendGroup interface exists with getStats as its own prototype method.
WebTransportSendStream exists and extends WritableStream directly.
WebTransportSendStream.prototype carries its own sendGroup, sendOrder, getStats, and getWriter members.
new WebTransportSendGroup() throws a TypeError — groups are minted only by createSendGroup().
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransportSendGroup !== 'function') return false; try { new WebTransportSendGroup(); return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()

assertions.description: createSendGroup() on a connecting transport returns a real WebTransportSendGroup synchronously.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || !('createSendGroup' in WebTransport.prototype)) return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const g = t.createSendGroup(); const ok = typeof WebTransportSendGroup === 'function' ? g instanceof WebTransportSendGroup : typeof g.getStats === 'function'; try { t.close(); } catch {} return ok; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: createUnidirectionalStream converts its WebTransportSendStreamOptions dictionary (sendGroup, sendOrder) synchronously at the call, observed via throwing-getter-free getters, even though the stream resolves later.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); let so = false, sg = false; const p = t.createUnidirectionalStream({ get sendOrder() { so = true; return 7; }, get sendGroup() { sg = true; return null; } }); p.catch(() => {}); try { t.close(); } catch {} return so && sg; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: WebTransportSendStream.prototype.getWriter is its OWN override (returning the specialised WebTransportWriter), not the inherited WritableStream.prototype.getWriter.

On a live outgoing stream, getStats() resolves { bytesWritten, bytesSent, bytesAcknowledged } with bytesAcknowledged <= bytesSent <= bytesWritten; the group's getStats aggregates its streams. Needs an established HTTP/3 session to obtain a stream, which this showcase cannot reach.
assertions.test: Requires a live HTTP/3 WebTransport server; createUnidirectionalStream only resolves after establishment.

assertions.description: WebTransportSendStream is [Transferable]: a live instance can be posted to a worker with a transfer list. Needs a live instance, so it cannot execute here.
assertions.test: Requires a live instance from an established session to postMessage with a transfer list.
